scope: All source-designated normal and fault trace CSV, raw Duration per pod+operation, chrono first half reference and second half control, q95/99/99.5 abs deviation from median; root appended after measurement aggregation. Injection-to-next-injection only descriptive intervals, not onset or known failure ends. No OR across channels or propagation truth.
limitations: One short normal trace window/date; correlated spans and load/operation coverage may affect tails; native Duration units not converted until compared timestamps. Differences outside root do not establish causal propagation. Absent normal operation is missing reference, never zero score. Last injection interval includes later observed trace points, not confirmed failure duration.
